<html>
  <head>
    <style>
      body {
        font-family: "Segoe UI", Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
      }
      .table {
        display: table;
        max-width: 1178px;
        background-color: white;
        border: 2px solid black;
        border-radius: 6px;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
      }
      .tr {       
        display: table-row;
        background-color: white;
        
      }
      .table .tr:nth-child(even) {
        display: table-row;
            background-color: whitesmoke;
            
        }
      .td {
        padding: 8px;
        display: table-cell;
      }

      .btnCopy {
        float: right;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .btnCopy:hover {
        cursor: pointer;
        scale: 1.1;
      }
      .btnCopy:active {
        cursor: pointer;
        scale: 0.9;
      }
      .rowHeader {
        font-weight: 500;
        font-size: 13pt;
      }
      .rowHash {
        font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
        font-weight: normal;
        font-size: 12pt;
        line-height: 32px;
      }
      .msgCopied {
        position: fixed;        
        overflow: hidden;
        top: 50px;
        padding: 6px;
        width: 300px;
        visibility: hidden;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
        z-index: 99;
        border: 2px solid green;
        background-color: aliceblue;
        border-radius: 6px;
        text-align: center;
        box-shadow: 1px 1px 24px #969696;
  	    
      }
      .zgxlogo {
        display: block;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
        margin-top: 20px;
      }
      .copyright{
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 10;
        font-weight: 500;
      }

      @media only screen and (max-device-width: 480px) {
        body {
          font-family: "Segoe UI", Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
          font-size: 24pt;
        }
        .table {
          display: table;
          position: absolute;
          max-width: 1178px;
          width: 80%;
          background-color: white;
          border: 2px solid black;
          border-radius: 6px;
          padding: 8px;
          left: 0;
          right: 0;
          margin-left: auto;
          margin-right: auto;
        }
        .rowHeader {
          font-weight: 500;
          font-size: 36px;
          line-height: 1.5em;
        }
        .rowHash {
          font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
          font-weight: normal;
          font-size: 30pt;
          line-height: 1.2em;
        }
        .btnCopy {
          width: 96px;
          height: 96px;
          float: right;
          cursor: pointer;
        }
        .btnCopy:hover {
          cursor: pointer;
          scale: 1.1;
        }
        .btnCopy:active {
          cursor: pointer;
          scale: 0.9;
        }
        .msgCopied {
          width: 80%;
          font-weight: 600;
        }
      }
    </style>
    <script>
      function copyToClipboard(text) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(
          function () {
            console.log("Hash copied successfully!");
          },
          function (err) {
            console.error(" Could not copy hash: ", err);
          }
        );
      }
      function getCurrentYear(){
        let currentDate = new Date();
        let cYear = currentDate.getFullYear();
        document.write(cYear);
      }
    </script>

  </head>
  <body>
     
    <div>
      <p>
        <span class="arcName">Archive: <b>{0}</b></span
        ><br />
        <span class="arcSize">Size: <b>{1}</b></span
        ><br />
        <span class="arcDate">Last write time: <b>{2}</b></span
        ><br />
        <span class="arcFiles">Files: <b>{3}</b></span
        ><br />
        <span class="hashInfo">Files hashed with <b>{4}</b></span>
      </p>
    </div>
    <div class="table">      
      <!--Copy to clipboard success msg-->
      <div class="msgCopied" id="msgCopied">Hash copied to clipboard.</div>
      <!--Rows here-->
      {5}
    </div>
    <!--Copyright-->
    <div >
      <a href="https://www.zipgenius.it" target="_blank">
      <img class="zgxlogo"
        src="data:image/png;base64,"
      /></a>
      <p class="copyright">Copyright ©<script>getCurrentYear();</script> The ZipGenius Team - <a href="https://www.zipgenius.it" target="_blank"><b>https://www.zipgenius.it</b></a> - all rights reserved.</p>
    </div>
   
    <!-- copyToClipBoard code-->
    <script>
      function copyToClipboard(elID) {
        var text = document.getElementById(elID).innerText;
        if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
          // navigator clipboard api method'
          return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(
            function () {
              var msg = document.getElementById("msgCopied");
              msg.style.visibility = "visible";
              setTimeout(() => {
                msg.style.visibility = "hidden";
              }, 3000);
            },
            function (err) {
              console.error("Async: Could not copy text: ", err);
            }
          );
        } else {
          // text area method
          let textArea = document.createElement("textarea");
          textArea.value = text;
          // make the textarea out of viewport
          textArea.style.position = "fixed";
          textArea.style.left = "-999999px";
          textArea.style.top = "-999999px";
          document.body.appendChild(textArea);
          textArea.focus();
          textArea.select();
          return new Promise((res, rej) => {
            // here the magic happens
            document.execCommand("copy") ? res() : rej();
            textArea.remove();
          }).then(
            function () {
              var msg = document.getElementById("msgCopied");
              msg.style.visibility = "visible";
              setTimeout(() => {
                msg.style.visibility = "hidden";
              }, 3000);
            },
            function (err) {
              console.error("Async: Could not copy text: ", err);
            }
          );
        }

        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(
          function () {
            var msg = document.getElementById("msgCopied");
            msg.style.visibility = "visible";
            setTimeout(() => {
              msg.style.visibility = "hidden";
            }, 3000);
          },
          function (err) {
            console.error("Async: Could not copy text: ", err);
          }
        );
      }
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
